name: images_variations
description: Generate image-variation grid; each tile becomes its own creation (creations_wait → results.tiles). Modes: angles|demographics|expressions|age|storyboard|custom. Defaults: angles, 3x3, 1:1, 4k.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

prompt.description: Required for custom; used for storyboard.

selectedAngles.description: Angles mode labels, ideally one per tile.
